plan.note: Fresh independent exact-commit native builds. Byte-identical measurement helpers for A/B, including benchmark-only zero-shift N+1 reader wrapper. Same dependencies; no A/A. Private lscratch staged once, evicted before every sample with <=1% residency for every measured file. Four separate 200-event pixel/address preflights. Bulk on/off, batch20, depth1, 6GiB/BD, KvikIO8threads/1MiB, compatibility ON. No calibration/user kernel/field API in timed loop.

read_wait_breakdown.aggregation: Per sample, mean over four BD ranks; then mean and sample SD across four samples. Nonwait = rank loop_s - rank read_wait_s. Not a decomposition of max-rank headline loop time.
read_wait_breakdown.limits: Host future.get wait includes transfer/scheduling and overlap effects; not pure disk latency or isolated alignment cost. Balanced AB/BA order reduces bias without guaranteeing cancellation.
